title: Grilled Flank Steak
summary: Salt-and-pepper flank, hot and fast on the grill, sliced thin against the grain. Built for a sharp sauce on top.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Pat the steak dry, season with salt and pepper, and let it sit out while the grill heats. Earlier is better if there's time.

steps.title: Heat the grill
steps.text: Get the grill very hot and oil the grates.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Grill hot and fast to about 130°F for medium-rare, 4 to 5 minutes a side. Flank goes from pink to tough quickly, so pull it on time.

steps.title: Rest and slice
steps.text: Rest, then slice thin across the grain. Find the long muscle lines and cut straight across them.

notes: Flank is lean, so the sauce does a lot of the work: chimichurri for brightness, or the chipotle butter for richness. Also works sliced into tortillas as carne asada-style tacos.
